title: Dconf 2014 Day 2 Keynote: The Last Thing D Needs -- Scott Meyers
summary: Scott Meyers' keynote at DConf 2014, drawing on 25 years of C++ experience to offer the D language community a plea about what it should avoid. It centers on the accumulated complexity and pitfalls of C++ as a cautionary tale.
why: HN commenters bring it up whenever C++ complexity or the pitfalls of language design come up, as a witty and authoritative warning.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

quote.text: everyone should watch Scott Meyers's awesome presentation at a D conference
